spec.name: Soft star illustration
spec.description: A friendly scalable celestial illustration built from layered bounded primitives.

request: Create a reusable warm celestial illustration for large seated-care targets using the available ellipse, rounded rect and line primitives. Use a coherent gold/cream/teal palette, layered shapes, soft outline and simple twinkle details. No URLs, text, paths, filters or markup. Use idle, selected, completed and disabled state scales and gentle-pulse. It must be recognizable and attractive rather than a single generic circle. The trusted renderer will control size and state.
